What's new in v1.2.22

  • Auto-correct no longer garbles text when you type fast. If you kept typing while a finished word was being corrected, your new characters landed in the middle of the fix — mixed-up text and conversions of the wrong letters. The keys you press during a correction are now held for those few milliseconds and typed back right after it, so the text ends up exactly as you typed it.
